confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Porto price levels; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Cafe, beer and restaurant anchors are more reliable than July accommodation rates. The cocktail and wine anchors were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. The FX observation comes from RBA search-result summaries; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Positioned modestly below Lisbon and in line with other popular Southern European city-break destinations such as Seville and Valencia; July accommodation reflects peak-season demand.
